brief:
Hamas and the Democratic Front for the Liberation of Palestine held bilateral talks in Cairo to discuss political developments, electoral obligations, and ways to strengthen joint national action, Shehab Wire reported. A Hamas Political Bureau member headed the delegation for the meeting.

The discussions focused on current political circumstances facing the Palestinian territories and strategies for deepening coordination between the two factions. Both groups examined electoral requirements and mechanisms for expanding their collaborative efforts on national priorities. The talks reflected ongoing efforts by Palestinian political movements to align positions on key issues affecting Palestinian society.

title: Hamas meets Democratic Front in Cairo to discuss national issues
